main_topics.reason: The user repeatedly said they wanted to be part of the decision to switch from infliximab and asked about alternatives to Humira.
The user asked what other treatment classes exist and questioned why another anti-TNF was recommended after infliximab stopped working.
The user said the consultant brushed them off and that others treated them as awkward for asking questions.
The user asked whether requesting a second opinion could cause problems on the NHS and worried it might seem like going behind the consultant's back.

output.summary: The user was furious that their consultant presented switching from infliximab to Humira as settled and had brushed off questions about alternatives. The assistant discussed other biologic classes, suggested asking about drug levels and antibodies, helped prepare appointment questions, and reassured the user about requesting a second opinion. The user said they felt they had a plan and intended to book an appointment and take the list.
